description: Wire the three-flavor SNAPSHOT into the live shell as a two-phase async flow. Depends on FEAT-001 (SnapshotPayload::from_window_capture, clipboard_html::build_cf_html, screenshot::color_image_to_raster, the CF_HTML place() arm, and the Unicode-boxed Markdown). Bare SNAPSHOT becomes a REQUEST that stashes the model-derived Markdown text and asks for a window screenshot; the egui frame loop issues the ViewportCommand::Screenshot, and when the Event::Screenshot arrives it assembles the picture (real window RGBA -> PNG + DIB) + text + CF_HTML and places all three in one transaction. Non-blocking. Explicit SNAPSHOT <FORMAT> file/PDF paths and the no-picker behaviour stay exactly as-is.
steps: Add shell pending-snapshot state: in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/state.rs add a grouped field (mirroring pending_menu_option / pending_tab_actions) holding an Option<PendingSnapshot { text: String }> plus a request flag (e.g. snapshot_screenshot_requested: bool). Initialise it in the shell struct literal in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/construct.rs. Keep it a grouped sub-struct, not a loose god-struct field where a group fits.

Rework crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/commands_snapshot.rs::snapshot_composite_to_clipboard into the REQUEST phase: resolve active_screen_capture() (handle ScreenCapture::OptOut with the existing not-capturable error), render SnapshotFormat::Markdown text (now Unicode-boxed via FEAT-001), store PendingSnapshot{ text } and set the request flag; do NOT build a payload or touch the clipboard here. Remove the synchronous SnapshotPayload::from_model + OsClipboard.place from the bare path. Leave handle_snapshot dispatch, snapshot_single_format_to_file, and snapshot_to_pdf unchanged. Adjust the #[cfg(test)] bare-SNAPSHOT test to assert the pending request is set (not synchronous placement).

In crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/update.rs (impl eframe::App for WorkbenchShell::update), near the existing deferred-action drains: (a) if snapshot_screenshot_requested, clear it and ctx.send_viewport_cmd(egui::ViewportCommand::Screenshot(egui::UserData::default())) while leaving PendingSnapshot in place; (b) scan ctx.input(|i| i.raw.events) for egui::Event::Screenshot { image, .. } and when one arrives AND a PendingSnapshot is waiting: raster = screenshot::color_image_to_raster(&image); build payload = SnapshotPayload::from_window_capture(raster, pending.text.clone()); set payload.html = Some(clipboard_html::build_cf_html(&payload.png, &pre_text)) where pre_text is the Unicode box-drawn body; call OsClipboard.place(&payload); set the success/partial/failure status via the existing ff-desktop-shell-msg-scrm-snapshot-* i18n keys; clear PendingSnapshot. Document the overlay-in-frame behaviour (a SNAPSHOT taken with a modal up captures the overlay) in the module doc.

Confirm the dispatch seam is unchanged: commands_ladder_b.rs still routes SNAPSHOT through handle_snapshot via the single front door; no bespoke intercept, no second dispatcher (framework-conformance).
Run the scoped verification trio + scoped tests for both crates and read the logs; clean up any temporary logs under _ignore/logs/.
acceptance_criteria: Bare SNAPSHOT no longer rasterises the text for the clipboard picture; it requests a window screenshot and, on the Event::Screenshot frame, places CF_UNICODETEXT (Unicode-boxed Markdown), CF_DIB+CF_DIBV5 (from the real window RGBA), and CF_HTML in one clipboard transaction. The flow is non-blocking (no spin-wait on the screenshot).
Explicit SNAPSHOT TEXT/ANSI/MARKDOWN/MD/HTML/YAML/AI/PNG/PDF still write single-format files/PDF unchanged; ANSI never reaches the clipboard; there is no format picker.
cargo check -p ff-desktop succeeds; the reworked snapshot command test asserts the pending-request contract for bare SNAPSHOT.
ff-screen-model remains egui-free (no egui use added to it); the only egui-touching new code is crate::screenshot in ff-desktop.
The single command-dispatch seam is preserved (SNAPSHOT via handle_snapshot; no new intercept/dispatcher).
verification: NOTE: the live 'picture pastes into Word showing both image and box-drawn text' proof is the OWNER's manual Word paste; a headless host cannot assert the Win32 clipboard contract or a live window screenshot. Do NOT run the whole suite or cargo gate (owner-manual per testing.md).
findings:
FEAT-002 complete and compile-verified in the worktree (branch scrm-2b). Bare SNAPSHOT is now the two-phase async flow consuming the FEAT-001 building blocks.

== Shell state (grouped sub-struct, not loose fields) ==
- crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/state_groups.rs: added PendingSnapshot { text: String, pre_text: String } and SnapshotState { pending: Option<PendingSnapshot>, screenshot_requested: bool }. NOTE deviation from the literal step-1 wording 'PendingSnapshot { text: String }': I also store pre_text (the plain Unicode box-drawn body for the CF_HTML <pre>). RATIONALE: both text flavors are model-derived and the ScreenProvider seam only exists in the command phase; rendering BOTH there keeps the frame loop (update.rs) egui-only and never touching ff_screen_model. text = Markdown-fenced (CF_UNICODETEXT); pre_text = ff_screen_model::render(&model, PlainText, RenderOptions::default()) (default = unicode_box:true, the U+2500-family box body) for the <pre>.
- crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/state.rs: added `pub(super) snapshot: state_groups::SnapshotState` near the scrm fields.
- crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/construct.rs: initialised `snapshot: state_groups::SnapshotState::default()`.

== REQUEST phase (command) ==
- crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/commands_snapshot.rs::snapshot_composite_to_clipboard REWORKED: resolves active_screen_capture() (OptOut still errors with the existing not-capturable message), renders text (Markdown) + pre_text (PlainText default), stores PendingSnapshot and sets snapshot.screenshot_requested = true, clears open_error. It no longer builds a payload or touches the clipboard (removed the synchronous from_model + OsClipboard.place). handle_snapshot dispatch, snapshot_single_format_to_file, and snapshot_to_pdf are UNCHANGED (explicit SNAPSHOT <FORMAT> file/PDF paths and ANSI-never-to-clipboard behaviour are exactly as before; no picker).

== ASSEMBLY phase (frame loop) ==
- crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/commands_snapshot.rs::place_snapshot_composite(&mut self, image: &egui::ColorImage, pending: PendingSnapshot) NEW helper (keeps update.rs tidy / <40-line functions): raster = crate::screenshot::color_image_to_raster(image); payload = SnapshotPayload::from_window_capture(raster, pending.text); payload.html = Some(crate::clipboard_html::build_cf_html(&payload.png, &pending.pre_text)); OsClipboard.place(&payload); sets the ff-desktop-shell-msg-scrm-snapshot-both-copied / -copied / -no-clipboard i18n status.
- crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/update.rs (impl eframe::App::update, by the deferred-action drains): (a) if snapshot.screenshot_requested, clear it and ctx.send_viewport_cmd(ViewportCommand::Screenshot(UserData::default())) leaving pending in place; (b) when a pending request is waiting, scan ctx.input(|i| i.raw.events) for Event::Screenshot { image, .. } (image: Arc<ColorImage>, cloned out of the closure), and on arrival take() the pending and call place_snapshot_composite(&image, pending). Non-blocking: no spin-wait. Module doc documents the overlay-in-frame behaviour (a SNAPSHOT with a modal up captures the overlay in the PICTURE; the TEXT flavors come from the logical model, so they reflect the Context, not a transient overlay).

== dead_code allows removed now that FEAT-001 code is live ==
- screenshot.rs::color_image_to_raster, clipboard_html.rs::build_cf_html, clipboard_backend.rs::SnapshotPayload::from_window_capture: the FEAT-001 `#[allow(dead_code)]` markers removed (now called).
- clipboard_backend.rs::SnapshotPayload::from_model: production no longer calls it (the live path captures the REAL window via from_window_capture, not a synthetic model raster), so it is now marked `#[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]` with a note; it stays as the model-only constructor the clipboard_backend unit tests assert against. (This resolves the one dead_code warning `cargo check` surfaced after the rework; clippy -D warnings is then clean.)

== Dispatch seam UNCHANGED (framework-conformance) ==
- commands_ladder_b.rs still routes `SNAPSHOT` / `SNAPSHOT <arg>` through handle_snapshot via the single front door. No bespoke intercept, no second dispatcher added.
